Actions.note: A / detail action picker — list and run plugin actions on a task; same runner as the CLI and command palette

JumpToNotification.note: g; toasts also carry an Open action

JumpToPinned.note: shift+↑ jumps to first pinned task in column

JumpToUnpinned.note: shift+↓ jumps to first unpinned task in column

New.note: n, ⌘N, titlebar button; the form's Host selector (shown when a placement plugin offers machines) posts the chosen host as placement

OpenBrowser.note: b — opens task branch in browser

OpenWorktree.note: o / Editor button — opens worktree in code editor

Plugins.note: m / ⌘M — PluginsView: search the plugin catalog, read what each one does, install or remove it in one click

Queue.note: x, Execute button, drag to In Progress

Refresh.note: R; SSE keeps board live anyway

Routines.note: u / ⌘U — fleet view with last-run status, schedules, run-now, log viewer

ToggleDangerous.note: ! cycles permission mode for new executions

ToggleShellPane.note: Shell tab in the detail terminal panel — local or remotely placed workdir shell; remote desktop and browser input/output use the host-aware terminal API

PlaceTask.note: @ opens placement in the TUI; task detail placement panel in desktop and browser.

ToggleListView.note: v — swaps the four columns for one flat line per task (TaskList.tsx); persisted via board_display_mode

SavedViews.note: V — saved-view picker: apply, save the current filter, delete (ListMenus.tsx). The query is resolved server-side so the grammar has one implementation

ListOptions.note: O — arrange the list: group by status/project/none, sort by urgency/updated/created/title; persisted via list_group_by and list_sort
